say:1:1033328001:1.text: This beautiful wreath, costs only twelve nickles for a good marriage!
say:1:1033328001:1.source_cn: 还有可以为带来姻缘的花冠，一顶只需十二枚铜币！
say:1:1033328001:1.male: This beautiful wreath, costs only twelve nickles for a good marriage!
say:1:1033328001:1.female: This beautiful wreath, costs only twelve nickles for a good marriage!

say:2:1033328002:1.text: I learned it elsewhere—the people of Taran in the Vaduso Mountains are said to wear this at their weddings.
say:2:1033328002:1.source_cn: 这是我从别处学到的手艺，据说在瓦度索山脉的塔兰村，那里...
say:2:1033328002:1.male: I learned it elsewhere—the people of Taran in the Vaduso Mountains are said to wear this at their weddings.
say:2:1033328002:1.female: I learned it elsewhere—the people of Taran in the Vaduso Mountains are said to wear this at their weddings.

say:3:1033328003:1.text: Wait, you don't look like a Wilder... How did you get into our village?
say:3:1033328003:1.source_cn: 等等，我看你好像并不是绿裔成员，你是怎么进到我们村子的？
say:3:1033328003:1.male: Wait, you don't look like a Wilder... How did you get into our village?
say:3:1033328003:1.female: Wait, you don't look like a Wilder... How did you get into our village?

say:5:1033328004:1.text: Of course! Ever since the Thorned Guards sealed off the forest, I never saw any Lightbearers in Lunadorf again.
say:5:1033328004:1.source_cn: 当然！自从荆棘封锁丛林之后，月湖村就再没出现过耀光人。

say:6:1033328005:1.text: I miss those old, busy days...
say:6:1033328005:1.source_cn: 真怀念以前繁忙充实的日子。
